segment.description: Ocoee River No. 1 reach below Parksville Dam (Parksville Lake tailwater), Polk County
segment.boundaries: Parksville Dam downstream through the Ocoee No. 1 (scheduled recreational flow) reach

coldSource.notes: Parksville is a shallow warmwater reservoir TVA/TWRA manage primarily for walleye (TWRA Parksville Reservoir page: walleye spawn at 42-50 F), not a deep cold-storage impoundment; no document found stating a cold withdrawal. USGS 03564500 (Ocoee River at Parksville, ~717 ft) is the correct-reach site but carries NO temperature parameter (verified via USGS site catalog and IV query) - note: prior project flags said this gauge was 'not live'; the site exists in the USGS catalog.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found; TWRA's own program for this reach is spring-only (Mar, Apr, May rainbow per the owner-supplied 2026-09-17 workbook), which does not rely on summer carry-over.

wildPopulation.detail: No evidence of natural reproduction found in this pass; unknown.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TWRA stocks this reach only March-May and agency/outdoor sources describe the lower Ocoee as warm summer water (walleye-managed reservoir, smallmouth-favoring pools) - no cold-storage mechanism or summer trout data was found.
